On Wed, Oct 7, 2026 at 9:12 AM Kira Patel <kira.patel@bridgewell.com> wrote:
> Attached is our consolidated redline...

Kira — thanks for the clear packet. Suggested contract language for fallback and subprocessor sequencing below; feel free to copy into your redline as an alternative to the BridgeWell drafting.

Suggested fallback paragraph (short):
"If a hosting region identified in the Order Form becomes subject to regulatory restriction or export-control blocking after signature, the parties will: (i) promptly notify each other; (ii) temporarily reroute processing to an alternative region listed in the Order Form that is functionally equivalent; (iii) provide BridgeWell with commercially reasonable mitigation options, including transitional export-addenda and access to prior-processed data under secured transfer; and (iv) where necessary, engage the SCCs Annex 3 fallback procedure within thirty (30) days to document the route change."

Subprocessor approval sequencing (short):
- Redwood will maintain an up-to-date subprocessor roster and provide evidence of onboarding checks;
- For high-risk subprocessors (as defined in Annex), Redwood will offer BridgeWell thirty (30) days to object before onboarding completes;
- For non-standard hosting routes (Azure private deploy), a scoped exception addendum will be required and pricing elements may apply.

I'll attach a one-paragraph SCCs cross-reference to the DPA and flag Annex 3 as the locus for the fallback flow.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
